item.title: Record cohort of students prepare to receive Catholic sacraments through Notre Dame's OCIA program

item.title: Notre Dame receives "F" grade from Students for Life of America
item.description: In their Mid-Year Report Card for Christian Schools, Students for Life of America dropped Notre Dame's grade from a "B" to an "F"grade. The update was announced Feb. 12. According toa SFLA news releasefollowing the decision, the downgradecame as a direct result ofprofessor Susan Ostermann's appointment as director of the Keough School of Global Affairs' Liu Institute of Asia and Asian Studies.
